speech.heard: China protects 96% of toddlers against hepatitis B in Sudan. It's just 39%. Sudan is the world's lowest, leaving most toddlers without full coverage. Full protection requires three doses of the vaccine before or during a child's second year. The USA hits 93%. India climbs to 94%. Climbing higher, Nigeria is at 67%. Germany has 85%. Brazil hits 90% and Russia hits 97%. Near the top, Costa Rica protects 99% of its toddlers, 2.5 times Sudan. How well protected are toddlers in your country?
